overview: Canada is the second-largest country in the world by area, covering most of the northern half of North America. Its capital is Ottawa and its largest city is Toronto. Canada is a constitutional monarchy and a federation of ten provinces and three territories. English and French are both official languages, and French is the main language in the province of Quebec.

geography.text: Canada has coastlines on three oceans, the Pacific, the Atlantic and the Arctic, and the longest coastline of any country. The Rocky Mountains rise in the west, the Prairies cover the middle, and the ancient rocks of the Canadian Shield, dotted with lakes, cover much of the centre and east. Canada has more lakes than any other country, and most Canadians live in the south, close to the border with the United States.
